meta.name: dev-plan
meta.description: Strategic planning with optional interview workflow. Use when the user wants to plan before implementing — "plan this", "let's plan", structured requirements gathering for vague ideas. Pairs with @compass-planner agent. Supports consensus mode and review mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊想法变成可执行的计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前先做结构化规划
copy.tagline_en: Turn vague ideas into actionable plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured planning before implementation

howto.what: 当你说出模糊需求时，Claude 会先通过一问一答收集细节，然后生成可执行的计划，包含行号引用和可测试的标准。计划保存到 workspace/projects/plans/。批准后可以交给其他工具执行。
howto.when: 当你说“plan this”、“let's plan”或要求 review 计划时触发。对于模糊需求默认进入采访模式；也可以通过 --direct 或 --review 参数指定模式。

say.text: 先帮我做个计划，我有个模糊的想法。
say.note: Claude会开始采访，逐步明确需求。
Claude会评审已有计划并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: When you express a vague request, Claude first gathers details through question-and-answer, then generates an actionable plan with file:line references and testable criteria. The plan is saved to workspace/projects/plans/. After approval, it can be handed off to other tools for execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "plan this", "let's plan", or ask for a review. For vague requests, it enters interview mode by default; you can also specify --direct or --review to choose modes.

say_en.text: Help me plan this project. I have a vague idea.
say_en.note: Claude starts interviewing to clarify requirements.

say_en.text: Review this plan file and suggest improvements.
